definitions: An object made by shaping molten metal or other material in a mould.
The set of actors in a play, film, or show.
A throw of dice or a fishing line.
A rigid surgical dressing, typically made of plaster of Paris, used to immobilize an injured part of the body.
examples: The entire cast took a bow.
A lucky cast of the dice.
Her arm was in a cast for six weeks.
